# Clean and filter datasets
```{r}

#unparse column names first
LCNEC4 <- do.call(data.frame, c(as.list(organoids_ccf_data[["LCNEC4"]]), check.names = FALSE))
#filter data
LCNEC4_clean <- filter_clonal(LCNEC4, K=3, filter_fixed=T)

SINET9 <- do.call(data.frame, c(as.list(organoids_ccf_data[["SINET9"]]), check.names = FALSE))
SINET9_clean <- filter_clonal(SINET9, K=3, filter_fixed=T)

```
```{r}
prepare_ccf <- function(raw) {
  # flatten matrix columns (subclonal.fractions, DP, ...) into ordinary columns
  flat <- do.call(data.frame, c(as.list(raw), check.names = FALSE))

  # CCF and depth columns, paired by sample name
  ccf_cols <- grep("^subclonal\\.fractions\\.", names(flat), value = TRUE)
  dp_cols  <- sub("^subclonal\\.fractions\\.", "DP.", ccf_cols)
  K        <- length(ccf_cols)

  # your filter: subclonal loci only, and not 0 in all sub-populations
  filtered <- filter_clonal(flat, K = K)

  list(data = filtered, ccf_cols = ccf_cols, dp_cols = dp_cols, K = K)
}
```

## Check the prepared data before running bootstrap
```{r}
prep <- lapply(data_samples, prepare_ccf)

for (e in names(prep)) {
  p <- prep[[e]]
  cat("\n==", e, "==\n")
  cat("K =", p$K, "| loci:", nrow(p$data), "\n")
  cat("CCF columns:", p$ccf_cols, "\n")
  cat("DP columns: ", p$dp_cols, "\n")
  cat("CCF at positions 3..:", identical(names(p$data)[3:(2 + p$K)], p$ccf_cols), "\n")
  cat("all DP columns present:", all(p$dp_cols %in% names(p$data)), "\n")
  cat("duplicated mutations:", sum(duplicated(p$data[, c("chr", "pos")])), "\n")
  cat("missing CCF / DP:", sum(is.na(p$data[, p$ccf_cols])), "/", sum(is.na(p$data[, p$dp_cols])), "\n")
}
```

```{r summary of sequencing depth}
depth_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(prep), function(e) {
```

# Run bootstrap
```{r test}
# quick test with a small B, also to measure time
p <- prep[["LCNEC3"]]
set.seed(2021)
system.time(test <- boot_ccf(p$data, ccf_cols = p$ccf_cols, dp_cols = p$dp_cols, B = 20))
test$mean
```

### Run on two samples
```{r}
LCNEC4 <- prep$LCNEC4
SINET8 <- prep$SINET8

set.seed(2021)
res_LCNEC4 <- boot_ccf(LCNEC4$data, ccf_cols = LCNEC4$ccf_cols, dp_cols = LCNEC4$dp_cols, B = 100)
res_SINET8 <- boot_ccf(SINET8$data, ccf_cols = SINET8$ccf_cols, dp_cols = SINET8$dp_cols, B = 100)
```

## Run on all samples
```{r}
# full run for all experiments
```

## Plot two samples
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
plot_experiment <- function(e) {
  est <- res_ccf[[e]]$estimate
  get <- function(s) est$value[est$statistic == s]
  gg  <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                      K = prep[[e]]$K, ci = res_ccf[[e]]$mean,
                      ci_style = "bands", mean_style = "crosshair", ci_alpha = 0.4)
  gg[[1]] <- gg[[1]] + ggtitle(e)
  gg[[1]] + gg[[2]] + gg[[3]]
}

res_ccf <- list(SINET8 = res_SINET8, LCNEC4 = res_LCNEC4)
names(res_ccf)              # "SINET8" "LCNEC4"
names(res_ccf$LCNEC4)       # "estimate" "mean" "B" "level" "type"

plot_experiment("LCNEC4")
plot_experiment("SINET8")
```

```{r caterpillar plots}
caterpillar_ccf <- function(res, stat, y_label, ylim = NULL) {
  f <- res$estimate[res$estimate$statistic == stat & !is.na(res$estimate$value), ]
  f <- f[order(f$value), ]
  f$rank <- seq_len(nrow(f))
  m <- res$mean[res$mean$statistic == stat, ]            # mean over loci, with its interval

  ggplot(f, aes(x = rank, y = value, ymin = value_lower, ymax = value_upper)) +
    geom_linerange(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = m$value, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(x = paste0("Loci (ranked by ", stat, ")"), y = y_label) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw()
}

plot_caterpillars <- function(res, title = NULL, ylim = c(0, 1)) {
  p_fst  <- caterpillar_ccf(res, "FST",  expression(italic(F[ST])),       ylim)
  p_gpst <- caterpillar_ccf(res, "G'ST", expression(italic(G*minute[ST])), ylim)
  p_d    <- caterpillar_ccf(res, "D",    expression(italic(D)),            ylim)
  p_m <- caterpillar_ccf(res, "M", expression(italic(M)), ylim = c(0, 1))
  (p_fst + p_gpst + p_d + p_m) + plot_annotation(title = title)
}

plot_caterpillars(res_ccf$SINET8, title = "SINET8")
plot_caterpillars(res_ccf$LCNEC4, title = "LCNEC4")
```


## Plot individual bootstrap distributions
```{r}
p   <- prep$LCNEC4
CCF <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$ccf_cols])
DP  <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$dp_cols])

obs <- diff_biallelic(CCF)
set.seed(2021)
reps <- lapply(1:10, function(b) diff_biallelic(ccf_resample(CCF, DP)))

# one row of three panels (FST, G'ST, D) from a loci x 4 matrix
bounds_row <- function(mat, title) {
  gg <- ggbounds_raw(M = mat[, "M"], FST = mat[, "FST"], GpST = mat[, "G'ST"], D = mat[, "D"],
                     K = p$K, density_colors = TRUE, mean_style = "bound")
  gg[[1]] <- gg[[1]] + ggtitle(title)
  gg[[1]] + gg[[2]] + gg[[3]]
}

# observed and the first three replicates, one row each
bounds_row(obs, "observed") /
bounds_row(reps[[1]], "replicate 1") /
bounds_row(reps[[2]], "replicate 2") /
bounds_row(reps[[3]], "replicate 3")
```

```{r}
boot_all <- do.call(rbind, reps)                      # all replicates stacked: (10 x loci) x 4

gg <- ggbounds_raw(M = obs[, "M"], FST = obs[, "FST"], GpST = obs[, "G'ST"], D = obs[, "D"],
                   K = p$K, density_colors = TRUE, point_color = "black", mean_style = "bound")


add_boot <- function(plot, stat) {
  pts <- data.frame(M = boot_all[, "M"], y = boot_all[, stat])
  plot$layers <- c(geom_point(data = pts, aes(x = M, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                              colour = "grey75", size = 0.3, na.rm = TRUE),
                   plot$layers)                       # bootstrap points drawn first, behind everything
  plot
}

add_boot(gg[[1]], "FST") + add_boot(gg[[2]], "G'ST") + add_boot(gg[[3]], "D")
```
```{r effect of one replicate}
p   <- prep$LCNEC4
CCF <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$ccf_cols])
DP  <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$dp_cols])

obs <- diff_biallelic(CCF)
set.seed(2021)
rep1 <- diff_biallelic(ccf_resample(CCF, DP))         # one bootstrap replicate

gg <- ggbounds_raw(M = obs[, "M"], FST = obs[, "FST"], GpST = obs[, "G'ST"], D = obs[, "D"],
                   K = p$K, density_colors = TRUE, point_color = "black", mean_style = "bound")

add_boot <- function(plot, boot_mat, stat) {
  pts <- data.frame(M = boot_mat[, "M"], y = boot_mat[, stat])
  plot$layers <- c(geom_point(data = pts, aes(x = M, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                              colour = "grey65", size = 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                   plot$layers)                       # replicate points drawn first, behind
  plot
}

add_moves <- function(plot, obs_mat, boot_mat, stat) {
  seg <- data.frame(x = obs_mat[, "M"], y = obs_mat[, stat],
                    xend = boot_mat[, "M"], yend = boot_mat[, stat])
  seg <- seg[complete.cases(seg), ]
  plot$layers <- c(geom_segment(data = seg, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                                inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2),
                   plot$layers)
  plot
}

add_moves(add_boot(gg[[1]], rep1, "FST"), obs, rep1, "FST") +
  add_moves(add_boot(gg[[2]], rep1, "G'ST"), obs, rep1, "G'ST") +
  add_moves(add_boot(gg[[3]], rep1, "D"), obs, rep1, "D")
```


## Plot resampling of CCF
```{r Observed versus resampled CCF, per locus and sample}
p   <- prep$SINET8
CCF <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$ccf_cols])
DP  <- as.matrix(p$data[, p$dp_cols])

set.seed(2021)
CCF_b <- ccf_resample(CCF, DP)                       # one replicate

scatter_df <- data.frame(sample   = rep(p$ccf_cols, each = nrow(CCF)),
                         observed = as.vector(CCF),
                         resampled = as.vector(CCF_b))
scatter_df$sample <- sub("^subclonal\\.fractions\\.", "", scatter_df$sample)

ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = observed, y = resampled)) +
  geom_abline(colour = "red") +
  geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "observed CCF", y = "resampled CCF (one replicate)") +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r Distribution of CCFs per sample, observed versus 10 replicates}
set.seed(2021)
reps <- lapply(1:10, function(b) ccf_resample(CCF, DP))

to_long <- function(mat, source) data.frame(
  source = source,
  sample = rep(sub("^subclonal\\.fractions\\.", "", p$ccf_cols), each = nrow(mat)),
  ccf    = as.vector(mat))

dist_df <- rbind(to_long(CCF, "observed"),
                 do.call(rbind, lapply(1:10, function(b) to_long(reps[[b]], paste("rep", b)))))
dist_df$type <- ifelse(dist_df$source == "observed", "observed", "bootstrap")

ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = ccf, group = source, colour = type, linewidth = type)) +
  geom_freqpoly(binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(observed = "black", bootstrap = "grey60")) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(observed = 0.8, bootstrap = 0.3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "CCF", y = "number of loci", colour = NULL, linewidth = NULL) +
  theme_bw()
```

# Standard error
```{r}
sem <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

sem_ccf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_ccf), function(e) {
  est <- res_ccf[[e]]$estimate
  do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
    x <- est$value[est$statistic == s]
    data.frame(experiment = e,
               K          = prep[[e]]$K,
               n_loci     = sum(!is.na(x)),
               statistic  = s,
               mean       = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
               SEM_loci   = sem(x))
  }))
}))
sem_ccf
```

```{r}
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")
sapply(stats, function(s) summary(sem_ccf[sem_ccf$statistic==s,]$SEM_loci))
```


#### Cluster SEM option
```{r}
sem <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

se_cluster <- function(value, unit) {
  ok  <- !is.na(value) & !is.na(unit); value <- value[ok]; unit <- unit[ok]
  n_u <- tapply(value, unit, length); m_u <- tapply(value, unit, mean)
  w   <- n_u / sum(n_u); m <- sum(w * m_u); U <- length(m_u)
  sqrt(U / (U - 1) * sum(w^2 * (m_u - m)^2))
}

se_table_ccf <- function(e, unit = c("cluster", "mutation")) {
  unit <- match.arg(unit)
  est  <- res_ccf[[e]]$estimate
  dat  <- prep[[e]]$data

  tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D"), function(s) {
    f   <- est[est$statistic == s, ]
    f   <- f[order(f$locus), ]
    m   <- mean(f$value, na.rm = TRUE)
    err <- if (unit == "mutation") sem(f$value)
           else se_cluster(f$value, dat$Cluster[f$locus])
    data.frame(statistic = s, value = m, value_lower = m - err, value_upper = m + err, SE = err)
  }))

  # no error bar for M (as in the toad figures)
  is_m <- tab$statistic == "M"
  tab$value_lower[is_m] <- tab$value_upper[is_m] <- tab$value[is_m]
  tab
}

se_tab <- lapply(names(res_ccf), se_table_ccf, unit = "cluster")
names(se_tab) <- names(res_ccf)
se_tab$LCNEC4
```
